description: Change of Use from Flexible Commercial (Use Class A1-A5; B1; and D1) to a fitness related recovery studio and social wellness club (Use Class E(d)(b))
decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun within 3 years from the date of this permission.
Reason: To prevent the accumulation of unimplemented planning permissions and to comply with Section 91 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 (as amended) and to meet the requirements of Section 51 of the Planning and Compulsory Purchase Act 2004 and to meet the requirements of The Town and Country Planning (Development Management Procedure) (England) Order 2015.
Condition : 2 - The development shall be carried out in accordance with the reports, specifications and drawings detailed (01)-01, 26-J-4981-01 REV: A, (05)-01, NOISE IMPACT ASSESSMENT REVISION 01 DATED: 13 JULY 2026
Reason: To ensure a satisfactory standard of development and to allow the local planning authority to review any potential changes to the scheme. 
Condition : 3 - Notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015 (as amended) or any Order revoking, amending and re-enacting the Order the development hereby approved shall be used only as a fitness related recovery studio and social wellness club (and ancillary cafe) and for no other purpose (including any other purpose in Class E of the Schedule to the Town and Country Planning (Use Classes) Order 1987, or in any provision equivalent to that Class in any statutory instrument revoking and re-enacting that Order with or without modification). In accordance with policy LP2 and LP14 of the Local Plan.
Reason: To safeguard the amenities of the neighbourhood by ensuring that other uses which could cause a loss of amenity do not commence without prior approval in accordance with the National Planning Policy Framework.
Condition : 4 - The use hereby permitted shall not be open to customers other than between the hours of:
(a) [06:00-22:00] Mondays - Fridays 
(b) [08:00-20:00] Saturday - Sunday and Bank Holidays 

Reason: To safeguard the amenities of the neighbourhood, in accordance with Council policy LP2 of the Local Plan  coupled with the requirements of the National Planning Policy Framework.
Condition : 5 - Prior to first operation of the use hereby approved, submit for approval a noise management plan detailing measures to mitigate against the impact of airborne noise resulting from any event involving a live DJ or any other live musical performance. The management plan shall include (but not be limited to) details of: event management and neighbour consultation.
Reason: To protect the amenity of neighbouring occupants, in accordance with Local Plan Policy LP2. 
Condition : 6 - In the event that any hot food is proposed to be prepared at the premises, prior to the commencement of the sale of such food, a scheme for the extraction and treatment of fumes and odours generated from commercial cooking undertaken within the development shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority. Any equipment, plant or process approved pursuant to such details shall be operated and retained in accordance with the approved details and operated in accordance with the manufacturer's instructions.
Reason: To protect neighbour amenity, in accordance with Local Plan Policy LP2.
Condition : 7 - Prior to the first use of the development, details of all fixed plant, machinery and equipment associated with the development, including but not limited to: pumps, filtration systems, water treatment equipment, ventilation systems, motors and associated ancillary equipment, together with details of all proposed noise attenuation and vibration isolation measures, shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.
The submitted details shall demonstrate that noise arising from the operation of the plant and equipment will not exceed:
o	NR25 within any bedroom of the residential dwellings above; and
o	NR30 within any living room of the residential dwellings above,

when assessed in accordance with the latest version of BS 8233 and the Noise Rating (NR) methodology.
All pumps, motors and other vibration-generating equipment shall be mounted on suitable anti-vibration isolators and all associated pipework shall be acoustically isolated from the building structure using flexible connections and other appropriate vibration attenuation measures. The approved noise and vibration control measures shall be installed prior to the commencement of the use and shall be retained and maintained thereafter.
Reason: To protect neighbour amenity, in accordance with Local Plan Policy LP2.

Condition : 8 - INFORMATIVE: In dealing with this application the Council has implemented the requirement in the National Planning Policy Framework to work with the applicant in a positive and proactive manner and the Council has, as far as practicable, sought solutions to problems arising in relation to dealing with the planning application. The Council has made available detailed advice in the form of its statutory policies in the Local Plan (2023) as well as offering a full pre-application advice service, in order to ensure that the applicant has been given every opportunity to submit an application which is likely to be considered favourably. In addition, where appropriate, further guidance was offered to the applicant during the processing of the application.
Condition : 9 - INFORMATIVE: The footway and carriageway on Swandon Way must not be blocked during the site works. Temporary obstructions during works must be kept to a minimum and should not encroach on the clear space needed to provide safe passage for pedestrians or obstruct the flow of traffic on the TLRN. 
Condition : 10 - INFORMATIVE: All vehicles associated with the site demolition & construction must only park/ stop at permitted locations and within the time periods permitted by existing on-street restrictions.  Any dispensations to allow for construction should be applied for as per TfL website ( Dispensations on TfL's red routes - Transport for London)
Condition : 11 - INFORMATIVE: The applicant is strongly encouraged to commit to the usage of electrical freight for construction vehicles whilst providing EV charging facilities in line with both Policy T7 and T1. Consolidation measures and the usage of sustainable last-mile movements within construction trip generation are strongly encouraged to reduce carbon emissions to further with Policy SI1 and minimise unnecessary vehicle movements to align with London Plan Policy GG6 (Increasing efficiency and resilience) and support TfL's Vision Zero commitment
